title.en: HBT8018 Concrete Pump — 132 kW here is a motor — read beside “Work done”
title.zh: 按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018——是 60 m³/h。——对照「功 完成」来读

description.en: HBT8018 Concrete Pump at /products/hbt8018-concrete-pump. 132 kW here is a motor The cell says 4 cm and below
description.zh: 按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018见 /products/hbt8018-concrete-pump。是 60 m³/h。格子写 4 cm 及以下。

h1.en: Energy converted is the heading; HBT8018 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「能量 converted」，主体仍是按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for HBT8018 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/hbt8018-concrete-pump. 132 kW here is a motor. The cell says 4 cm and below. This page prints HBT8018-132S. Electric 80’s cell says 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Diesel 120’s 290 kW is two diesel engines. The 100 mm of length is a printed difference. Electric 80 also prints 60 m³/h, but at 110 kW and 900 m / 300 m. HBT80-16 prints 6600 mm at the same 6500 kg and the same 1750 mm width. If the motor you can feed is 132 kW and the labels you are matching are 150 m and 450 m, this is the path. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S as 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. The section title “Work done” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT8018 at 132 kW, 60 m³/h, conveying 150 m and delivery height 450 m. The code is HBT8018-132S, not HBT80-1816-110.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018的数字。要打开的行是 /products/hbt8018-concrete-pump。是 60 m³/h。格子写 4 cm 及以下。这里的 132 kW 是电机。这一页印 HBT8018-132S。这 100 mm 长度是印出来的差别。柴油120的 290 kW 是两台柴油机。电动80的格子写 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。电动80也印 60 m³/h，但是 110 kW 和 900 m / 300 m。HBT80-16 在同样的 6500 kg 和同样的 1750 mm 宽度下印 6600 mm。如果你能供给的电机是 132 kW，并且对照的标题是 150 m 和 450 m，路径就是这一页。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S 印成 132 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。节标题「功 完成」来自来源页，不另加额定值。 河北品锦机械在邢台把 HBT8018 印成 132 kW、60 m³/h、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m。代码是 HBT8018-132S，不是 HBT80-1816-110。

body.en: “Work done” titles this part of the HBT8018 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. 132 kW here is a motor. Diesel 120’s 290 kW is two diesel engines. If the motor you can feed is 132 kW and the labels you are matching are 150 m and 450 m, this is the path.
body.zh: 「功 完成」是按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。河北品锦机械（邢台）把 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S 印成 132 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、输送高度 450 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。柴油120的 290 kW 是两台柴油机。如果你能供给的电机是 132 kW，并且对照的标题是 150 m 和 450 m，路径就是这一页。

body.en: For HBT8018 Concrete Pump, the heading “Energy converted” does not replace a cell. The cell says 4 cm and below. The 100 mm of length is a printed difference. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S as 132 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m, delivery height 450 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg.
body.zh: 对按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018而言，标题「能量 converted」并不替换任何格子。格子写 4 cm 及以下。这 100 mm 长度是印出来的差别。是 60 m³/h。

heading.en: Example - Power needed to lift a Mass
heading.zh: 示例 - 功率 needed 到 提升 质量

body.en: HBT8018 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Example - Power needed to lift a Mass”. This page prints HBT8018-132S. Electric 80 also prints 60 m³/h, but at 110 kW and 900 m / 300 m.
body.zh: 按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018不因标题「示例 - 功率 needed 到 提升 质量」而改动。这一页印 HBT8018-132S。电动80也印 60 m³/h，但是 110 kW 和 900 m / 300 m。这里的 132 kW 是电机。

heading.en: Example - Work done by an Electric Motor
heading.zh: 示例 - 功 完成 通过 电动 电机

body.en: This section is titled “Example - Work done by an Electric Motor”. HBT8018 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Electric 80’s cell says 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). HBT80-16 prints 6600 mm at the same 6500 kg and the same 1750 mm width. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-d_1289.html.
body.zh: 本节标题是「示例 - 功 完成 通过 电动 电机」。按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动80的格子写 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）。HBT80-16 在同样的 6500 kg 和同样的 1750 mm 宽度下印 6600 mm。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-d_1289.html。

question.en: Does “Work done” replace 132 kW here is a motor?
question.zh: 「功 完成」会替换「是 60 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. 132 kW here is a motor remains the printed wording for HBT8018 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。是 60 m³/h。仍是按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018已印的说法。

question.en: Where does The cell says 4 cm and below belong on the HBT8018 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018这一行里，「格子写 4 cm 及以下。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/hbt8018-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/hbt8018-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Energy converted” add to HBT8018 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「能量 converted」给按 132 kW 电机和 450 m 输送高度订 HBT8018增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-d_1289.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/power-d_1289.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。
